# Before opening an issue

Please read the following list before creating a new issue:

- This issue tracker is not supposed to be used for questions on how to use invoice-builder. It is intended to be used for bug reports and feature requests! In case you face yourself with a usage question, then post your question e.g. on [Discussions](https://github.com/piratuks/invoice-builder/discussions).
- Have you already used the [github search](https://github.com/piratuks/invoice-builder/issues), read the documentation and looked at the examples?
- Make sure to use the latest version of invoice-builder for bug reports.
- For bug reports, include the app mode (Desktop or Web), application version, operating system, and browser version when using Web mode.
- Include clear reproduction steps and, where possible, sanitized sample data, screenshots, or logs. Do not include customer or financial data.
- Delete this list from the actual issue.
